identity_levels.STRICT: Maximum identity lock; variation_tolerance typically <= 0.10; IP-Adapter weight high.
identity_levels.MEDIUM: Balanced identity lock; variation_tolerance typically 0.10–0.30; allows lighting/pose drift.
identity_levels.LOOSE: Soft identity lock; variation_tolerance typically >= 0.30; preserves object class over instance detail.

object_reference_bank_structure.entries: Array of object reference records keyed by object_id.
object_reference_bank_structure.entry_fields: object_id, source_movie, source_scene, source_shot, reference_bank_id, identity_level, variation_tolerance, anchor_images, anchor_descriptors, identity_signature, memory_signature, traceability_signature.
object_reference_bank_structure.indexing: Primary index by object_id; secondary indexes by identity_signature and source_video_id + source_scene.

object_anchor_format.anchor_kind: Anchor classification enum: prop | furniture | vehicle | container | handheld | architectural_detail | object_anchor.
object_anchor_format.normalized_position: Vec3 [x,y,z] in screen-normalized space from spatial graph object_nodes.
object_anchor_format.importance: Anchor persistence weight in [0,1] derived from object blocking layout.
object_anchor_format.object_class: Object class label for variation_tolerance fallback matching.
object_anchor_format.identity_level: Identity lock enum: strict | medium | loose.

object_memory_format.movie_id: Parent movie identifier for scene object memory store.
object_memory_format.scene_id: Scene identifier binding memory entry to spatial graph scene.
object_memory_format.object_anchors: Map of object_id to anchor positions persisted across shots.
object_memory_format.object_anchor_reuse: Boolean flag indicating object anchor reused from reference bank entry.
object_memory_format.reference_bank_id: Optional link to object reference bank record when reused.
object_memory_format.identity_level: Identity lock enum bound at memory capture time.
object_memory_format.persistence_score: Cross-shot object anchor stability score in [0,1].

object_reconstruction_traceability_forma.traceability_id: Unique traceability record for object reconstruction lineage.
object_reconstruction_traceability_forma.source_video_id: Canonical numerical DNA source identifier (e.g. TITANIC_02).
object_reconstruction_traceability_forma.source_scene_id: Full source scene identifier from scene_remap engine.
object_reconstruction_traceability_forma.source_shot_id: Full source shot identifier from scene_remap engine.
object_reconstruction_traceability_forma.identity_embedding_ref: Reserved IP-Adapter identity embedding path (metadata placeholder).
object_reconstruction_traceability_forma.traceability_signature: Deterministic hash binding all lineage fields.

object_variation_tolerance_format.identity_level: Identity lock enum: strict | medium | loose.
object_variation_tolerance_format.variation_tolerance: Allowed identity drift score in [0,1]; lower = stricter lock.

object_retrieval_strategy.description: Retrieve object reference bank entry by object_id first; fall back to identity_signature match; apply variation_tolerance band from identity_level for IP-Adapter weight selection without GPU execution.

analysis.object_identity: object_identity preservation_score=0.55 with HIGH loss; object_identity map not exported and IP-Adapter embeddings unavailable in current adapter stack.
analysis.object_reference_bank: Central bank stores per-object identity, memory, and traceability signatures derived from numerical DNA and spatial graph object_nodes; enables ip_adapter_identity_reference_bank recovery path.
analysis.object_anchor_reuse: Object anchor descriptors from blocking layout map to bank entries; scene_object_memory enables cross-shot object_anchor_reuse when reference_bank_id is stable.
analysis.scene_object_memory: Scene object memory records object_anchors per scene_id; memory_signature hashes anchor positions and identity_level for continuity validation across reconstruction shots.
analysis.object_reconstruction_traceability: traceability_signature binds source_video_id, scene_remap gonegi_scene_id, conditioning map export path, and reserved identity_embedding_ref for full lineage audit.
analysis.object_variation_tolerance: identity_level (strict | medium | loose) governs variation_tolerance band and lock_strength; strict props (suitcase_001) require low drift; loose furniture (chair_014) permits higher variation.
